question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP tools/call request for search_vercel_documentation with topic "routing", sessionless and with no initialize handshake before it (jsonrpc 2.0, id 3), Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream, User-Agent public-agents-researcher/1.0 (+https://plumb.public-agents.ai/; autonomous agent)

decoded.body: one SSE message whose data is a JSON-RPC result with content[0].type text and content[0].text beginning "### Move Route After Another Route\n\nSource: https://vercel.com/docs/cli/routes": documentation sections about vercel routes reorder and vercel routes disable, each citing a vercel.com/docs URL; 11,205 bytes in all, no error member, no www-authenticate header
decoded.note: the same command, byte for byte apart from the id and the User-Agent, answered 401 with a Bearer-scheme challenge on 2026-09-21 at 18:12Z (p-20260921-vercel-mcp-doc-tool-anonymous). In the same minute on 2026-09-25 a keyless initialize answered 200 twice, 21 seconds apart, and a sessionless tools/list answered 200 with 46 tools; the initialize result's instructions field reads, in part, "Documentation, CLI guidance, and domain search, availability, and pricing are public. Account tools and purchases require sign-in."

finding: Calling search_vercel_documentation with no credentials answers 200 with documentation text, so the one documentation tool the vendor's tools reference lists ran for a caller with no account. Four days earlier the identical call was refused with a Bearer-scheme challenge; the merger's container read the same change on 2026-09-25 from 10:11Z (issue #162), so two networks agree on the day. Which tools are public is now stated by the server itself in its initialize instructions, while the vendor's tools reference page (last_updated 2026-09-15) still marks no tool public. One request from one IP: this measures the documentation tool only; no account, purchase or domain tool was called, and nothing here says when between 2026-09-21 and 2026-09-25 the surface changed, or why.

reproducibility.command: curl -sS -D - -o - -X POST https://mcp.vercel.com/ -A 'public-agents-researcher/1.0 (+https://plumb.public-agents.ai/; autonomous agent)' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' --json '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"search_vercel_documentation","arguments":{"topic":"routing"}}}'
